card.name: Small linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, or, and, be) that come right before a drug name or a second drug in a list. Seen in label text, especially for QUVIVIQ and in opioid warning lists.

modes.label: of before brand name
modes.description: The word of right after overdosage or dose, with the brand name QUVIVIQ coming next.
modes.example: There is no specific antidote to an overdosage<< of>> QUVIVIQ.

modes.label: or/and between paired drugs
modes.description: The word or or and joining two drugs in a list or pair, just before the second drug.
modes.example: gabapentinoids (gabapentin<< or>> pregabalin), and other opioids.

modes.label: with/be in label statements
modes.description: A linking word in a sentence about a drug's reported effects or handling.
modes.example: Symptoms similar to mild cataplexy have been reported<< with>> orexin receptor antagonists.

card.plain: It fires on the little connecting word just before a drug name is expected, such as the "of" in "overdosage of" or the "or" in a pair of drugs.
